plugins.name: tech-llm-council
plugins.description: Pressure-tests a software, infrastructure or SaaS business decision with a council of 5 technical, product and business advisors, anonymous peer review and a chairman verdict. Optional SubQ Snap decision model through the separate subq-snap-mcp connector: picks advisor answers and the chairman verdict from fixed answer options with an improvement loop, plus routing, file relevance, strongest-response and agreement signals.
